# Disable hand tracking
set left hand_tracking_active false
set right hand_tracking_active false

# Reset positions
set head position 0.0 1.5 0.2
set head rotation 0.0 0.0 0.0 1.0
set left position -0.2 1.3 -0.3
set left rotation 0.4 0 0 0.9
set right position 0.2 1.3 -0.3
set right rotation 0.4 0 0 0.9

sleep 1
exec grim -g "0,0 ${GAME_VIEW_W}x${GAME_VIEW_H}" "${OUTPUT_DIR}/screenshot-01.png"
sleep 1

exec wtype -P Escape
sleep 1
exec swaymsg "[title=\"game.x64\"] focus"
exec wtype -p Escape
exec echo "sway seats list"
exec swaymsg -t get_seats
exec swaymsg 'seat seat0 keyboard key Escape press'
sleep 1
exec swaymsg 'seat seat0 keyboard key Escape release'

#exec wtype -k ESC
sleep 100
exec grim -g "0,0 ${GAME_VIEW_W}x${GAME_VIEW_H}" "${OUTPUT_DIR}/screenshot-02-menu.png"
sleep 1
